scripts.startup: $p = Start-Process dotnet -ArgumentList 'run','--project','ImageShare/ImageShare.csproj','--launch-profile','http' -PassThru -NoNewWindow; for ($i=0; $i -lt 30; $i++) { Start-Sleep 1; try { Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:5034 -TimeoutSec 2 -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null; Write-Host 'Startup verified'; $p.Kill(); exit 0 } catch {} }; Write-Host 'Startup failed'; $p.Kill(); exit 1
scripts.ci: dotnet r format:check && dotnet r build && dotnet r test && dotnet r startup
